title: Freefall means the only force acting is the object's weight
summary: An object is in freefall when the only force on it is its weight, the pull of gravity.
body: OpenStax Physics says that when the net outside force on an object is its weight, the object is in freefall. In that situation the only force acting is gravity. The page uses this as the meaning of the word, before it warns that a real drop near Earth is never that pure. Urone and Hinrichs, 26 March 2020. The definition is the textbook's, for the ideal case.
